verdict.rationale: TruffleHog verifies detected secrets against issuing services (login/API calls) via --only-verified and per-detector verification, confirmed by docs, GitHub README, and a hands-on probe that actually found 2 live-verified secrets among 8 findings. missing for 10: broader independent third-party corroboration of verification accuracy across many secret types beyond AWS/PrivateKey/URI in the probe run.
